BOOK ONE · LESSON 087

A car crash

车祸

A dialogue lesson on the present perfect and past simple tenses. Mr. Wood goes to the garage to collect his car, but the attendant says the mechanics are still working on it. In the garage they discover Mr. Wood's car has crashed into a lamp-post — the attendant tells him that he needs a new car. Workbook practice covers a fill-in-the-blank dialogue and a vocabulary exercise. Grammar exercises practise past tense/past participle forms, asking and answering 'Have you done it yet?' questions, answering 'Have they stopped?' questions, and completing dialogues with present-perfect questions and past-simple answers.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question.
Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?
听录音，然后回答问题。修理工能否修复伍德先生的汽车？

Listen to the recording, then answer: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?

  1. 1

    MR. WOOD

    Is my car ready yet?

    伍德先生：我的汽车修好了吗？

  2. 2

    ATTENDANT

    I don't know, sir.
    What's the number
    of your car?

    服务员：我不知道，先生。您的汽车牌号是多少？

  3. 3

    MR. WOOD

    It's LFZ 312 G.

    伍德先生：是 LFZ312G。

  4. 4

    ATTENDANT

    When did you bring it to us?

    服务员：您什么时候送来的？

  5. 5

    MR. WOOD

    I brought it here three days ago.

    伍德先生：3天前。

  6. 6

    ATTENDANT

    Ah yes, I remember now.

    服务员：啊，是的，我现在记起来了。

  7. 7

    MR. WOOD

    Have your mechanics finished yet?

    伍德先生：你们的机械师修好了吗？

  8. 8

    ATTENDANT

    No, they're still working on it.
    Let's go into the garage
    and have a look at it.

    服务员：没有，他们还在修呢。我们到车库去看一下吧。

  9. 9

    ATTENDANT

    Isn't that your car?

    服务员：这不是您的车吗？

  10. 10

    MR. WOOD

    Well, it was my car.

    伍德先生：唔，这曾是我的车。

  11. 11

    ATTENDANT

    Didn't you have a crash?

    服务员：您不是出车祸了吧？

  12. 12

    MR. WOOD

    That's right.
    I drove it into a lamp-post.
    Can your mechanics repair it?

    伍德先生：是啊。我把汽车撞在路灯柱上了。你们的机械师能修好吗？

  13. 13

    ATTENDANT

    Well,
    they're trying to repair it, sir.
    But to tell you the truth,
    you need a new car!

    服务员：啊，他们正设法修呢，先生。不过说实在的，您需要一辆新车了！

New words & expressions 生词和短语

attendant /əˈtendənt/
n. 接待员
bring /brɪŋ/ (brought /brɔːt/, brought)
v. 带来，送来
garage /ˈɡærɑːʒ/
n. 车库，汽车修理厂
crash /kræʃ/
n. 碰撞
lamp-post /læmp-pəʊst/
n. 灯杆，路灯柱
repair /rɪˈpeə/
v. 修理
try /traɪ/
v. 努力，设法

Notes on the text 课文注释

1

在英文中可以用一般疑问句的否定形式来表示期待、请求或希望得到肯定的答复，如课文中的 Isn't that your car? 和 Didn't you have a crash?

2

Well, it was my car.
well 是感叹词。在这里表示“哎”。was 用斜体，表示“过去是，现在不是了”。was 要重读。

3

drive into 是“撞到……”的意思。

4

they're trying to repair it, 他们正在设法修理。try 后面常接 to + 动词不定式。

B — Vocabulary

Choose and write in the correct word. 选词填空。

1. Can you ______ your car into the garage here next week, sir? (take / bring)
2. To ______ you the truth, I haven't finished the work yet. (say / tell)
3. The man is ______ trying to repair my bicycle. (still / yet)
4. The dentist ______ a look at Mr. Croft's teeth. (looked / had)
5. The garage ______ is looking at my car now. (assistant / attendant)
6. The girl ______ her bicycle into a tree. (drove / rode)
7. A car hit my bicycle. Can you ______ it for me? (repair / try)

Choose the correct word for each blank.

Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 87 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).
